reviews.title: Great quality for the money and they look nice
reviews.comment: For what seemed like a good idea at the time I built my PC using 140MM fans and a 280MM AIO cooler...not realizing how limited in options for radiator fans.  I wanted a nice pair of RGB fans for my radiator but could not find a nice one to my liking that was designed for radiators.  I tried regular RGB fans (plenty of those in 140mm) which looked great but they were made for airflow and just didn't do the trick against my radiator, temps were still higher than I wanted. High static fans in that size in RGB are far more limited in selection and the "best" were about $45 each, these I got for half of that and they work awesome.  Temps are down, quiet noise and they look awesome. The only complaint I have is that the fans have very low LED count, (only 8 per fan, most have at least 16+) and they cant be controlled individually, both fans are seen as one.  Outside of that I couldn't be happier and I highly recommend them if you want something made to go against a radiator
